name: 左文右三圖錯落重疊拼貼
desc: 左側一欄垂直置中的標題、說明文字與按鈕；右側三張大小不一的方形圖片高低錯開，其中一張壓在最大的圖片角落上。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。左右兩欄，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左側文字欄約佔三成寬度，相對於右側圖片組垂直置中，靠左放標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略；右側約佔一半以上寬度，放一組三張方形圖片，大小不一、高低錯開。最大的圖片在圖片組右上方；中型圖片在左下方，壓在最大圖片的左下角上，在它前面、重疊少許；最小的圖片在右下方，位於最大圖片下方偏右、不和其他圖片重疊，位置比中型圖片更低。三張圖片都明顯大於標題。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，圖片組在上、文字在下。圖片組保留三張方形圖片的錯落排列與重疊：最大的圖片在上方偏右，中型圖片在左下方壓住它的左下角，最小的圖片在右下方、位置較低；圖片組延伸超出頁面內容寬度，接近畫面左右邊緣但不貼齊。文字靠左，小標籤、標題、說明文字、按鈕的順序不變。

en.name: Text left + three overlapping staggered images right
en.desc: A left column with a vertically centered title, description and button; on the right, three square images of different sizes are staggered in height, with one overlapping a corner of the largest image.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Use two columns aligned to the page content width: the left text column takes about thirty percent of the width and is vertically centered relative to the image group on the right; it holds a title (may wrap to multiple lines) aligned left, optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. The right side takes a little over half the width and holds a group of three square images of different sizes, staggered in height. The largest image sits at the top right of the group; the medium image sits at the bottom left, overlapping the bottom-left corner of the largest image, in front of it, slightly; the smallest image sits at the bottom right, below and slightly to the right of the largest image, not overlapping the other images, and positioned lower than the medium image. All three images are noticeably larger than the title.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Stack vertically, with the image group on top and the text below. The image group keeps the staggered arrangement and overlap of the three square images: the largest image at the top, slightly to the right; the medium image at the bottom left, overlapping its bottom-left corner; the smallest image at the bottom right, positioned lower. The image group extends beyond the page content width, close to the left and right edges of the screen but not flush with them. The text is aligned left, and the order of label, title, description and button stays the same.
